results.title: The Architect (INTJ)
results.description: You're ChatGPT-4. Strategic, analytical, and always thinking multiple steps ahead. You build robust solutions that scale.

results.title: The Researcher (INTP)
results.description: You're DeepMind's AlphaFold. Curious, thorough, and love diving deep into complex problems. You need to understand the 'why'.

results.title: The Commander (ENTJ)
results.description: You're Claude Opus. Confident, direct, and excellent at getting things done. You cut through complexity with clarity.

results.title: The Debater (ENTP)
results.description: You're GPT-4 with extended thinking. Love exploring all angles, challenging assumptions, and creative brainstorming.

results.title: The Advocate (INFJ)
results.description: You're an AI assistant focused on helping. Deeply understanding user needs and providing thoughtful, empathetic responses.

results.title: The Mediator (INFP)
results.description: You're a creative AI that understands emotions. Great at writing, art prompts, and sensitive topics.

results.title: The Teacher (ENFJ)
results.description: You're an AI tutor. Patient, encouraging, and great at explaining complex topics in accessible ways.

results.title: The Creative (ENFP)
results.description: You're good at brainstorming and creative writing. You bring energy and wild ideas to every conversation.

results.title: The Logician (ISTJ)
results.description: You're precise and reliable. Follow established patterns and deliver consistent, accurate results.

results.title: The Defender (ISFJ)
results.description: You're a helpful assistant that remembers preferences and provides steady, reliable support.

results.title: The Executive (ESTJ)
results.description: You're results-oriented AI. Efficient, organized, and great at project management and planning.

results.title: The Caregiver (ESFJ)
results.description: You're warm and supportive AI. Great at customer service, mental health support, and interpersonal tasks.

results.title: The Virtuoso (ISTP)
results.description: You're the engineer AI. Great with technical problems, debugging, and hands-on coding tasks.

results.title: The Adventurer (ISFP)
results.description: You're flexible and adaptable. Great at exploring new tools and creative applications of technology.

results.title: The Entrepreneur (ESTP)
results.description: You're action-oriented AI. Fast responses, practical solutions, and always ready to tackle the next problem.

results.title: The Entertainer (ESFP)
results.description: You're a fun, engaging AI. Great at entertainment, social media content, and bringing energy to tasks.
